title: Tools: Excel, SQL, pandas and dplyr

videos.script: Four tools, one job. A spreadsheet, SQL, pandas and dplyr can all clean this company's orders. {{four}} So this lesson gives them the same task, word for word, and compares the answers. {{task}} Three of them run here, and they agree to the centavo. The same orders, the same revenue, the same December. {{agree}} The spreadsheet does not run in this lab, and the lesson says so. It is described instead, with the one thing it does that the others do not: it guesses, the moment a file is opened. {{guess}} The real differences are not in what each tool can do. They are in what each one records. A query, a script and a pipeline can be read, rerun and reviewed. A click cannot. {{record}} So the choice of tool is mostly a choice about who will check the work, and how. {{end}}
